pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Highly irregular, stellated geometries with jagged edge gradients and high angularity. Patches vary in size from medium to large with sharp transitions between light and dark pixel values.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting light-toned pathways of variable width forming a complex nodal network with distinct tri-point and quad-point intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck margin against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark, fusiform object with a pointed anterior protrusion perched on the dorsal ridge.
